notes: HSK 2 is a temple town and HSK 3 a river. HSK 2 units go gates, pagoda, gates, courtyard: walk up a road through red gates, climb a pagoda floor by floor, and sit round a courtyard with an incense burner. HSK 3 units go raft, stepping stones, raft, peaks: float down a river on a bamboo raft, hop stones across the water, and cross rope bridges between tall green peaks
